title: Fallout 3 Janus Bear — Exact Teddy/Gnome REFR Lifecycle and Reverse-Reference Gate v4.7
question: For each effective placed teddy or garden-gnome REFR, what direct lifecycle controls and reverse references exist, and is any high-value tableau source-bound strongly enough to test whether it predates the earliest possible conditional James_B origin?
lifecycle_fields: logical RefID and winning physical record
XESP enable-parent reference and flags where exposed
one exported edge per official-master ReferencedByIndex record

reverse_reference_semantics.purpose: Catch external QUST/SCPT/TERM/REFR and other record edges that may manipulate, condition, own or otherwise reference a target placed object.
reverse_reference_semantics.reason: Runtime logic or indirect mechanisms still require scene-specific review; the graph is evidence, not omniscience.

temporal_decision_rule.candidate: scene can be reached in a vanilla-compatible order before the conditional James_B capture point and no direct later-only dependency is yet known
temporal_decision_rule.effect: One hard pre-James_B tableau falsifies H2 JAMES_B_PLACED_ALL in tested scope but does not falsify H3 JAMES_OR_JAMES_B_PLACED_A_SUBSET.

high_value_scene_priority: Mothership Zeta Robot Assembly teddy + miniature intact gnome TV tableau
Presidential sub level two teddy bears + Help Us + camera gnome
Old Olney / S. Wilson teddy-gnome tableaux
Mobile Base Crawler teddy/skeleton and gnome tableaux

james_and_braun_cross_gate.james_source: Vault112PodTermDad / Dad status+stress / MQ04Doc gives an asset-level James session selector.
james_and_braun_cross_gate.braun_admin: Privileged Braun control is the preferred search domain for the still-missing memory-to-carrier write/rebind edge.
james_and_braun_cross_gate.placement_boundary: Even a fully established James_B creation mechanism would not establish teddy/gnome placement provenance.

verifier_classifications.DIRECT_DEPENDENCY_MARKER: At least one of Initially Disabled, XESP, script association, or official reverse reference is present and needs explicit review.
verifier_classifications.DIRECT_QUIET: No exported direct marker is present. This is only a static-lifecycle candidate, never automatic proof of permanent preexistence.
verifier_classifications.SOURCE_BOUND_TEMPORAL_FALSIFIER: Not emitted automatically by this verifier; requires a separately reviewed scene ledger satisfying the temporal decision rule.

manually bind high-value scene memberships to exact logical RefIDs

publish temporal verdict without promoting direct-quiet objects automatically
